about: Verified roster status of players in the Recruit Development Forecast (2025 class), kept under version control because the dashboard data file is hand-maintained in the deployment settings. Same format as the data file's watchClassStatus; the later verification date wins. A status never changes a forecast: it only moves the original prediction to the matching group. Add an entry only with a verification date and a source. "verified" is the date of the latest check named in the source; the source labels each date by what it is (an official-roster check or a data-snapshot date). "transferred" also needs "destination", supported by the cited portal or news record.

Chaz Coleman.source: Official roster check, 2026-10-17: not listed on Penn State's 2026 football roster (gopsusports.com/sports/football/roster, players #0 to #99). CFBD roster data snapshot, as of 2026-10-14: not on the 2026 roster. Transfer: left Penn State through the transfer portal for Tennessee (247Sports; CBS Sports).
